description: Defines classes and methods for Android shared audio sink using AudioTrack, including creation, validation, and management of audio sink objects, with focus on buffer sizing, threading, and error handling.

classes.name: AudioTrackAudioSinkType
classes.description: Manages creation, validation, and testing of Android audio sink types, including buffer size calculations.

classes.name: AudioTrackAudioSink
classes.description: Implements the audio sink using Android's AudioTrack, managing threading, data writing, volume, and error reporting.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Calculates minimum buffer size in frames based on channels, sample type, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an audio sink instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if an audio sink instance is valid and of the correct type.

methods.name: TestMinRequiredFrames
methods.description: Tests minimum required frames for buffer underrun prevention.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for the audio sink.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for the audio sink.

methods.name: GetUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the count of buffer underruns.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Returns the start threshold in frames.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Static method serving as the entry point for the audio thread.

methods.name: AudioThreadFunc
methods.description: Handles audio data processing in a separate thread.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes audio data to the audio track.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports errors encountered during audio processing.
